meta.title: Apply
meta.description: Apply for your visa online: travellers, documents, appointment and secure payment in one place.

summary.title: Your application
summary.pickFirst: Pick a destination to see the price.

visa.title: Where are you going?
visa.lead: Pick the destination and the visa — we'll show exactly what it costs.
visa.fallback: This purpose isn't offered — showing the tourist visa.

auth.title: First, your mobile number
auth.lead: We save your application to your number so you can continue anytime and get WhatsApp updates.

travelers.title: Who's travelling?
travelers.lead: Enter everyone exactly as in their passport. One application covers the whole family.
travelers.nameHint: Latin letters, as printed in the passport
travelers.expiryWarning: Expires less than 6 months after your return — most embassies will refuse it.
travelers.emailHint: Optional. We send the invoice and updates here too.
travelers.notOffered: This visa isn't offered for this traveller.

documents.title: Your documents
documents.lead: Upload a clear photo or PDF of each document. Our team reviews every page before submission.
documents.infected: Rejected by the virus scan — upload another file
documents.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {Everything's uploaded} one {# document to go} other {# documents to go}}
documents.privacy: Files go straight to encrypted storage, are virus-scanned, and only our reviewers can open them.

photoGuide.title: Photo checklist
items: Face centred, eyes open, no glasses
Even light, no shadows or filters

appointment.title: Your appointment
appointment.lead: Tell us where and when suits you — we'll watch the visa-centre calendar and book the earliest matching slot.
appointment.notesHint: e.g. mornings only, travelling with a baby

review.title: Check everything
review.lead: This is the price you'll pay — embassy and our fee always shown apart.
review.documentsCount: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} uploaded

couponErrors.coupon_not_applicable: This code doesn't apply to this visa.
couponErrors.coupon_min_order: The order is below this code's minimum.
couponErrors.coupon_exhausted: This code has been fully used.

review.consentTerms: I agree to the <terms>terms of service</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
review.consentData: I consent to myvisa processing my identity documents to prepare this application.
review.consentCrossBorder: I consent to my data being shared with the embassy or visa centre abroad for this application.

payment.title: Secure payment
payment.lead: You'll pay on the gateway's secure page and come straight back here.
payment.secure: PCI-DSS gateway · we never see your card number

confirmation.paidLead: We've got everything. A specialist reviews your file within 2 working hours and you'll get a WhatsApp update at every step.
nextSteps: We submit and follow up with the embassy
Your passport comes back with the visa
confirmation.failedLead: No money was taken. You can try again — your application and documents are saved.
confirmation.pendingLead: This can take a minute. Keep this page open — it updates by itself.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.latin_name: Use Latin letters as in the passport
errors.date_order: Must be after the start date
errors.traveler_ineligible: This visa isn't offered for one of the travellers.
errors.order_locked: This application can no longer be changed.
errors.file_type: This file type isn't accepted here

errors.order_not_payable: This order isn't waiting for payment.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
errors.otp_expired: The code expired. Request a new one.
errors.otp_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.

errors.invalid_saudi_mobile: Enter a Saudi mobile, e.g. 05X XXX XXXX.
